title: Docker Projects
description: Every running docker compose project and its services: status, uptime, CPU, RAM, network, disk, restarts, OOM, logs. New projects appear on their own (from cAdvisor docker labels).

list.name: New image deployed

options.content: Click a project name in **Projects** to filter the whole dashboard. In **Services**: service name = only that service, container name = its logs. Red = needs attention now: OOM, recently restarted, error logs, RAM near limit.
